title: Foster's time in the Jones Home before Armstrong; bugle and Ike Smoot
summary: The home had no band then, only a bugle played by Ike Smoot, who was killed after a dance before his band formed; Foster left about eighteen months before Armstrong arrived.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well, I was going to ask a couple of questions. Yeah, go ahead. Last time you were telling something about Jones' home, you said you were in the home for a while. For a while. Was that before Armstrong was there?
Before, yeah, before. He was not there when I was there. In other words, they didn't have no band at all.
Didn't have a band even.
Didn't have a band at all. They didn't even have a pair of sticks there.
Yeah.
What they did have, they had an old bugle. Well, they gave us little wooden guns which were drilled like soldiers.
Oh, yeah.
And the boy would blow the bugle.
Remember who was blowing the bugle?
Ike Smoot.
Oh, Ike Smoot.
Ike Smoot.
You mentioned the other day you thought he was better than Armstrong, you said?
Yeah, but he didn't. Before he could make his reputation, he died.
Did he ever play in any jazz bands or dance orchestra work?
Yeah, he played with a band they called the Poylton Band.
Which one?
Poylton.
Poylton.
Yeah.
Do you remember who else was in that?
Well. Were they young kids or older men? No, they were young kids. They were young kids. In other words, that's what they was going to name the band, you see?
Yeah.
Well, just as they got the band organized, he got killed.
Yeah. He got killed? How was that?
Got shot.
Oh, he did? Oh, yeah. Oh. Oh, what, in a fight or something?
Yeah, there was fighting.
Oh.
Yeah. Coming from a dance.
Oh. How long before Armstrong's time were you in that home? A year and a half. A year and a half before Armstrong. Before. Yeah. Well, you left a year and a half before Armstrong went in. Went in.
I see, yeah.
So, there must have been some time in that year and a half that they organized the band.
